events.title: Vessel collision — BW Maple × Dawn Kancheepuram
events.description: LPG tanker BW Maple (IMO 9346537, Singapore flag) and bulk carrier Dawn Kancheepuram (IMO 9368730, India flag) collided approximately 1.5 nautical miles east of Ennore Port entrance. The collision ruptured BW Maple's bunker fuel tank, releasing an estimated 196 tonnes of fuel oil.
events.source: Publicly documented — The Hindu, ITOPF records, Kamarajar Port Authority press releases
events.citation_or_dataset_identifier: ITOPF; The Hindu Jan 2017; Ministry of Shipping India

events.title: BW Maple — final approach to Ennore Port
events.description: Training AIS reconstruction: BW Maple decelerating on approach vector, speed reduced from 8.5 kn to 5.2 kn.
events.ui_warning: Training AIS reconstruction — NOT recorded AIS

events.title: BW Maple — AIS reporting gap begins
events.description: Training reconstruction: AIS transmissions from BW Maple cease shortly after collision point. 60-minute gap. Possible causes: antenna damage, transponder shock, deliberate cessation (not determined).
events.source: PALEGIC training reconstruction inferred from collision timeline

events.title: Dawn Kancheepuram — AIS reporting gap begins
events.description: Training reconstruction: AIS transmissions from Dawn Kancheepuram also cease around collision time.

events.title: BW Maple — AIS reporting resumes
events.description: Training reconstruction: AIS signal from BW Maple resumes after 150-minute gap. Vessel moving slowly eastward.

events.title: Dawn Kancheepuram — AIS reporting resumes
events.description: Training reconstruction: AIS signal from Dawn Kancheepuram resumes.

events.title: Sentinel-1A SAR acquisition
events.description: Sentinel-1A (C-SAR, IW mode, GRD product) passes over Bay of Bengal coast near Chennai. Approximate overpass time 04:30 UTC. The scene captures approximately 13.1°N–13.7°N, 79.8°E–81.0°E.
events.source: ESA Copernicus Open Access Hub — scene metadata

events.title: Oil slick detected on SAR — Ennore coast
events.description: Surface oil anomaly visible in SAR backscatter over Ennore coast and surrounding waters. For this prototype the detection polygon is an ILLUSTRATIVE mask derived from secondary published sources, not from automated SAR classification.
events.source: Illustrative mask derived from published news and ITOPF records
events.citation_or_dataset_identifier: The Hindu; ITOPF; NRSC media reports

events.title: Spill origin — collision site (documented)
events.description: The spill origin is the documented collision point, not inferred by PALEGIC. BW Maple×Dawn Kancheepuram collision coordinates published in official records.
events.citation_or_dataset_identifier: ITOPF incident database; Kamarajar Port Authority

events.title: AIS gap + proximity coincidence flagged
events.description: Both candidate vessels show AIS reporting gaps coinciding with the post-collision period. The slick centroid is within the gate radius of both vessels' last known positions. This constitutes CANDIDATE evidence requiring human review. It is NOT a finding of responsibility.
events.source: PALEGIC rank_sources heuristic — see ranking_method in case findings
events.notes: Priority score, not a probability of responsibility. Derived from training AIS, not recorded AIS.

events.title: Historical validation investigation closed
events.description: Case SIH-ENNORE-2017 closed as a historical validation demonstration. Responsible parties (BW Maple operators and shipping company) were identified by human investigators using primary evidence not available to this prototype. The PALEGIC workflow correctly surfaced both vessels as candidate sources for human review.
events.source: Public record — Directorate General of Shipping India; Tamil Nadu Coastal Police
events.citation_or_dataset_identifier: DGS India — incident closure report; ITOPF
